038/**
039 * Represents the parsed contents of a configuration.
040 *
041 * <h5 class='section'>Concurrency:</h5>
042 * <p>
043 * The parsed contents are held in a single immutable {@link State} snapshot published through a {@code volatile}
044 * reference.  Reads ({@link #getEntry(String,String)}, {@link #getKeys(String)}, {@link #getSections()},
045 * {@link #asMap()}, {@link #toString()}, etc.) are <b>lock-free</b>: they take a single snapshot of the current state
046 * and operate entirely on immutable collections, so there is no live-view leak and no
047 * {@link ConcurrentModificationException} hazard.  Writes ({@link #setEntry(String,String,String,String,String,List)},
048 * {@link #commit()}, {@link #onChange(String)}, etc.) build a fresh immutable state and swap it under a write lock,
049 * which is still required to make read-modify-write sequences atomic.
050 */
051@SuppressWarnings({
052   "resource", // Complex nested structure; value equality not practical
053   "java:S1206", // equals/hashCode not overridden; value equality not practical for this class
054})
055public class ConfigMap implements ConfigStoreListener {
056
057   static final class ConfigSection {
058
059      final String name;   // The config section name, or blank if the default section.  Never null.
060
061      final List<String> preLines;
062      final String rawLine;
063
064      final Map<String,ConfigMapEntry> oentries;
065      final Map<String,ConfigMapEntry> entries;
066
067      private ConfigSection(String name, String rawLine, List<String> preLines, Map<String,ConfigMapEntry> oentries, Map<String,ConfigMapEntry> entries) {
068         this.name = name;
069         this.rawLine = rawLine;
070         this.preLines = preLines;
071         this.oentries = oentries;
072         this.entries = entries;
073      }
074
075      /**
076       * Constructor for an empty (new) section.
077       */
078      ConfigSection(String name) {
079         this(name, "[" + name + "]", List.of(), Map.of(), Map.of());
080      }
081
082      /**
083       * Parses a section from a block of raw lines.
084       */
085      @SuppressWarnings({
086         "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for config section parsing
087      })
088      static ConfigSection parse(List<String> lines) {
089
090         String name2 = null;
091         String rawLine2 = null;
092
093         var preLines = new ArrayList<String>();
094         var entries = new LinkedHashMap<String,ConfigMapEntry>();
095
096         // S1: Looking for section.
097         // S2: Found section, looking for end.
098
099         var state = S1;
100         var start = 0;
101
102         for (var i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++) {
103            var l = lines.get(i);
104            var c = StringUtils.firstNonWhitespaceChar(l);
105            if (state == S1) {
106               if (c == '[') {
107                  var i1 = l.indexOf('[');
108                  var i2 = l.indexOf(']');
109                  name2 = l.substring(i1 + 1, i2).trim();
110                  rawLine2 = l;
111                  state = S2;
112                  start = i + 1;
113               } else {
114                  preLines.add(l);
115               }
116            } else {
117               if (c != '#' && l.indexOf('=') != -1) {
118                  var e = ConfigMapEntry.parse(l, lines.subList(start, i));
119                  if (entries.containsKey(e.key()))
120                     throw new ConfigException("Duplicate entry found in section [%s] of configuration:  %s", name2, e.key());
121                  entries.put(e.key(), e);
122                  start = i + 1;
123               }
124            }
125         }
126
127         // oentries and entries start identical; the immutable snapshot is shared safely.
128         var entriesU = u(entries);
129         return new ConfigSection(name2, rawLine2, u(preLines), entriesU, entriesU);
130      }
131
132      /**
133       * Returns a copy of this section with the specified entry added or replaced.
134       */
135      ConfigSection withEntry(ConfigMapEntry e) {
136         var m = new LinkedHashMap<>(entries);
137         m.put(e.key(), e);
138         return new ConfigSection(name, rawLine, preLines, oentries, u(m));
139      }
140
141      /**
142       * Returns a copy of this section with the specified entry removed.
143       */
144      ConfigSection withoutEntry(String key) {
145         if (! entries.containsKey(key))
146            return this;
147         var m = new LinkedHashMap<>(entries);
148         m.remove(key);
149         return new ConfigSection(name, rawLine, preLines, oentries, u(m));
150      }
151
152      /**
153       * Returns a copy of this section with the specified pre-lines.
154       */
155      ConfigSection withPreLines(List<String> preLines) {
156         return new ConfigSection(name, rawLine, u(cp(preLines)), oentries, entries);
157      }
158
159      Writer writeTo(Writer w) throws IOException {
160         for (var s : preLines)
161            w.append(s).append('\n');
162
163         if (! name.isEmpty())
164            w.append(rawLine).append('\n');
165         else {
166            // Need separation between default prelines and first-entry prelines.
167            if (! preLines.isEmpty())
168               w.append('\n');
169         }
170
171         for (var e : entries.values())
172            e.writeTo(w);
173
174         return w;
175      }
176   }

178   class Import {
179
180      private final ConfigMap configMap;
181      private final Map<ConfigEventListener,ConfigEventListener> listenerMap = synced(map());
182
183      Import(ConfigMap configMap) {
184         this.configMap = configMap;
185      }
186
187      @Override
188      public boolean equals(Object o) {
189         return o instanceof Import ir && ir.getConfigName().equals(getConfigName()); // HTT - Import.equals() only called via imports.contains() in findDiffs, which requires active import listeners
190      }
191
192      @Override
193      public int hashCode() {
194         return getConfigName().hashCode(); // HTT - Import.hashCode() only called when Import is used as map key, which requires active import functionality
195      }
196
197      ConfigMap getConfigMap() { return configMap; } // HTT - only called from import-related paths requiring active import listeners
198
199      String getConfigName() { return configMap.name; } // HTT - only called from import-related paths requiring active import listeners
200
201      synchronized Import register(Collection<ConfigEventListener> listeners) {
202         listeners.forEach(this::register);
203         return this;
204      }
205
206      synchronized Import register(ConfigEventListener listener) { // HTT - only called when registering with non-empty listener collection
207         var l2 = (ConfigEventListener)events -> {
208            var events2 = events.stream().filter(x -> ! hasEntry(x.getSection(), x.getKey())).collect(Collectors.toCollection(ConfigEvents::new));
209            if (! events2.isEmpty())
210               listener.onConfigChange(events2);
211         };
212         listenerMap.put(listener, l2);
213         configMap.register(l2);
214         return this;
215      }
216
217      synchronized Import unregister(ConfigEventListener listener) { // HTT - only called when import listener unregistration is triggered via unsupported import functionality
218         configMap.unregister(listenerMap.remove(listener));
219         return this;
220      }
221
222      synchronized Import unregisterAll() {
223         listenerMap.values().forEach(configMap::unregister);
224         listenerMap.clear();
225         return this;
226      }
227   }

229   /**
230    * Immutable snapshot of the parsed contents of a config.
231    *
232    * <p>
233    * All collections held here are unmodifiable.  A new instance is built for every mutation and published atomically
234    * through the {@code volatile} {@link ConfigMap#state} reference.
235    */
236   private record State(
237      String contents,
238      List<ConfigEvent> changes,
239      Map<String,ConfigSection> entries,
240      Map<String,ConfigSection> oentries,
241      List<Import> imports
242   ) {
243      State withChanges(List<ConfigEvent> changes) {
244         return new State(contents, changes, entries, oentries, imports);
245      }
246
247      State withImports(List<Import> imports) {
248         return new State(contents, changes, entries, oentries, imports);
249      }
250   }
251
252   private static void checkKeyName(String s) {
253      if (! isValidKeyName(s))
254         throw iaex("Invalid key name: '%s'", s);
255   }
256
257   private static void checkSectionName(String s) {
258      if (! ("".equals(s) || isValidNewSectionName(s)))
259         throw iaex("Invalid section name: '%s'", s);
260   }
261
262   private static boolean isValidConfigName(String s) {
263      s = s.trim();
264      if (s.isEmpty())
265         return false;
266      for (var i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
267         var c = s.charAt(i);
268         if (i == 0) {
269            if (! Character.isJavaIdentifierStart(c))
270               return false;
271         } else {
272            if (! Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(c))
273               return false;
274         }
275      }
276      return true;
277   }
278
279   private static boolean isValidKeyName(String s) {
280      if (s == null)
281         return false;
282      s = s.trim();
283      if (s.isEmpty())
284         return false;
285      for (var i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
286         var c = s.charAt(i);
287         if (c == '/' || c == '\\' || c == '[' || c == ']' || c == '=' || c == '#')
288            return false;
289      }
290      return true;
291   }
292
293   private static boolean isValidNewSectionName(String s) {
294      if (s == null)
295         return false;
296      s = s.trim();
297      if (s.isEmpty())
298         return false;
299      if (s.startsWith("/") || s.endsWith("/") || s.contains("//"))
300         return false;
301      for (var i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
302         var c = s.charAt(i);
303         if (c == '\\' || c == '[' || c == ']')
304            return false;
305      }
306      return true;
307   }

309   private final ConfigStore store;         // The store that created this object.
310   private final ConfigFormat format;       // Persistence format strategy.
311
312   final String name;                       // The name  of this object.
313
314   // Registered listeners listening for changes during saves or reloads.
315   private final Set<ConfigEventListener> listeners = new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
316
317   // The immutable copy-on-write snapshot of this map's contents.  Published atomically; read lock-free.
318   @SuppressWarnings("java:S3077") // Copy-on-write snapshot: State is a deeply-immutable graph (unmodifiable collections of immutable ConfigSection/ConfigMapEntry records) replaced wholesale under writeLock and never compound-mutated, so volatile safe-publication is sufficient for lock-free reads.
319   private volatile State state = new State("", List.of(), Map.of(), Map.of(), List.of());
320
321   private final SimpleReadWriteLock lock = new SimpleReadWriteLock();

352   /**
353    * Returns the values in this config map as a map of maps.
354    *
355    * <p>
356    * This is considered a snapshot copy of the config map.
357    *
358    * <p>
359    * The returned map is modifiable, but modifications to the returned map are not reflected in the config map.
360    *
361    * @return A copy of this config as a map of maps.
362    */
363   public JsonMap asMap() {
364      var st = state;
365      var m = new JsonMap();
366      st.imports().forEach(y -> m.putAll(y.getConfigMap().asMap()));
367      st.entries().values().forEach(z -> {
368         var m2 = mapOfType(String.class, String.class);
369         z.entries.values().forEach(y -> m2.put(y.key(), y.value()));
370         m.put(z.name, m2);
371      });
372      return m;
373   }
374
375   /**
376    * Persist any changes made to this map and signal all listeners.
377    *
378    * <p>
379    * If the underlying contents of the file have changed, this will reload it and apply the changes
380    * on top of the modified file.
381    *
382    * <p>
383    * Subsequent changes made to the underlying file will also be signaled to all listeners.
384    *
385    * <p>
386    * We try saving the file up to 10 times.
387    * <br>If the file keeps changing on the file system, we throw an exception.
388    *
389    * @return This object.
390    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
391    */
392   public ConfigMap commit() throws IOException {
393      try (var x = lock.write()) {
394         var newContents = asString();
395         for (var i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
396            if (i == 10)
397               throw new ConfigException("Unable to store contents of config to store.");
398         var currentContents = store.write(name, state.contents(), newContents);
399         if (currentContents == null)
400            break;
401         onChange(currentContents); // HTT - retry loop requires concurrent write conflict causing store.write() to return non-null
402         }
403         state = state.withChanges(List.of());
404      }
405      return this;
406   }

408   /**
409    * Reads an entry from this map.
410    *
411    * @param section
412    *    The section name.
413    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
414    *    <br>Use blank to refer to the default section.
415    * @param key
416    *    The entry key.
417    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
418    * @return The entry, or <jk>null</jk> if the entry doesn't exist.
419    */
420   public ConfigMapEntry getEntry(String section, String key) {
421      checkSectionName(section);
422      checkKeyName(key);
423      var st = state;
424      var cs = st.entries().get(section);
425      var ce = cs == null ? null : cs.entries.get(key);
426
427      if (ce == null)
428         ce = st.imports().stream().map(y -> y.getConfigMap().getEntry(section, key)).filter(Shorts::nn).findFirst().orElse(null);
429
430      return ce;
431   }
432
433   /**
434    * Returns the keys of the entries in the specified section.
435    *
436    * @param section
437    *    The section name.
438    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
439    *    <br>Use blank to refer to the default section.
440    * @return
441    *    An unmodifiable set of keys, or an empty set if the section doesn't exist.
442    */
443   public Set<String> getKeys(String section) {
444      checkSectionName(section);
445      var st = state;
446      var cs = st.entries().get(section);
447      Set<String> s = st.imports().isEmpty() && nn(cs) ? cs.entries.keySet() : set();
448      if (! st.imports().isEmpty()) {
449         st.imports().forEach(y -> s.addAll(y.getConfigMap().getKeys(section)));
450         if (nn(cs)) // HTT - requires imports where the section doesn't exist locally (cs==null), which needs active import listeners
451            s.addAll(cs.entries.keySet());
452      }
453      // Order-preserving immutable snapshot merging local + imported keys.
454      return u(cp(s));
455   }

483   /**
484    * Returns the keys of the entries in the specified section.
485    *
486    * @return
487    *    An unmodifiable set of keys.
488    */
489   public Set<String> getSections() {
490      var st = state;
491      var s = st.imports().isEmpty() ? st.entries().keySet() : setOfType(String.class);
492      if (! st.imports().isEmpty()) {
493         st.imports().forEach(y -> s.addAll(y.getConfigMap().getSections()));
494         s.addAll(st.entries().keySet());
495      }
496      // Order-preserving immutable snapshot merging local + imported sections.
497      return u(cp(s));
498   }

500   /**
501    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if this config has the specified section.
502    *
503    * @param section
504    *    The section name.
505    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
506    *    <br>Use blank to refer to the default section.
507    * @return <jk>true</jk> if this config has the specified section.
508    */
509   public boolean hasSection(String section) {
510      checkSectionName(section);
511      var st = state;
512      return nn(st.entries().get(section)) || st.imports().stream().anyMatch(x -> x.getConfigMap().hasSection(section)); // HTT - anyMatch() on imports requires active import listeners
513   }

515   /**
516    * Overwrites the contents of the config file.
517    *
518    * @param contents The new contents of the config file.
519    * @param synchronous Wait until the change has been persisted before returning this map.
520    * @return This object.
521    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
522    * @throws InterruptedException Thread was interrupted.
523    */
524   public ConfigMap load(String contents, boolean synchronous) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
525
526      if (synchronous) {
527         final var latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
528         var listener = (ConfigStoreListener)x -> latch.countDown();
529         store.register(name, listener);
530         store.write(name, null, contents);
531      if (latch.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
532         store.unregister(name, listener);
533      } else {
534         throw new ConfigException("Unable to store contents of config to store."); // HTT - timeout requires a store that doesn't fire change events within 30 seconds
535      }
536      } else {
537         store.write(name, null, contents);
538      }
539      return this;
540   }
541
542   @Override /* Overridden from ConfigStoreListener */
543   public void onChange(String newContents) {
544      ConfigEvents changes2 = null;
545      try (var x = lock.write()) {
546         if (neq(state.contents(), newContents)) {
547            changes2 = findDiffs(newContents);
548            load(newContents);
549
550            // Reapply our changes on top of the modifications.
551            state.changes().forEach(y -> applyChange(false, y));
552         }
553      } catch (IOException e) {
554         throw toRex(e); // HTT - IOException from findDiffs/load requires a failing store operation during onChange
555      }
556      if (changes2 != null && ! changes2.isEmpty())
557         signal(changes2);
558   }

590   /**
591    * Removes the import statement with the specified name.
592    *
593    * <p>
594    * The imported config is detached from this map: its entries are no longer visible through this map and its
595    * change-propagation listeners are unregistered.  No-op if no matching import exists.
596    *
597    * @param section
598    *    The section name where the import statement was placed.
599    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
600    *    <br>Use blank for the default section.
601    * @param importName
602    *    The import name.
603    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
604    * @return This object.
605    */
606   public ConfigMap removeImport(String section, String importName) {
607      checkSectionName(section);
608      try (var x = lock.write()) {
609         var st = state;
610         st.imports().stream().filter(y -> y.getConfigName().equals(importName)).findFirst().ifPresent(y -> {
611            y.unregisterAll();
612            var newImports = new ArrayList<>(st.imports());
613            newImports.remove(y);
614            state = st.withImports(u(newImports));
615         });
616      }
617      return this;
618   }

637   /**
638    * Does a rollback of any changes on this map currently in memory.
639    *
640    * @return This object.
641    */
642   public ConfigMap rollback() {
643      if (! state.changes().isEmpty()) {
644         try (var x = lock.write()) {
645            state = state.withChanges(List.of());
646            load(state.contents());
647      } catch (IOException e) {
648         throw toRex(e); // HTT - IOException from private load() is not possible in normal operation (scanner/section parsing doesn't throw)
649      }
650   }
651   return this;
652}

664    * @param value

666    *    <br>If <jk>null</jk>, the previous value will not be overwritten.

669    *    <br>If <jk>null</jk>, the previous value will not be overwritten.
670    * @param comment
671    *    Optional comment.

673    * @param preLines
674    *    Optional pre-lines.
675    *    <br>If <jk>null</jk>, the previous value will not be overwritten.
676    * @return This object.
677    */
678   public ConfigMap setEntry(String section, String key, String value, String modifiers, String comment, List<String> preLines) {
679      checkSectionName(section);
680      checkKeyName(key);
681      return applyChange(true, ConfigEvent.setEntry(name, section, key, value, modifiers, comment, preLines));

769   @SuppressWarnings({
770      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for config change application
771   })
772   private ConfigMap applyChange(boolean addToChangeList, ConfigEvent ce) {
773      try (var x = lock.write()) {
774         var st = state;
775         var section = ce.getSection();
776         var cs = st.entries().get(section);
777         var newEntries = new LinkedHashMap<>(st.entries());
778         switch (ce.getType()) {
779            case SET_ENTRY -> {
780               var cs2 = cs == null ? new ConfigSection(section) : cs;
781               var oe = cs2.entries.get(ce.getKey());
782               if (oe == null)
783                  oe = ConfigMapEntry.NULL;
784               // @formatter:off
785               cs2 = cs2.withEntry(new ConfigMapEntry(
786                  ce.getKey(),
787                  ce.getValue() == null ? oe.value() : ce.getValue(),
788                  ce.getModifiers() == null ? oe.modifiers() : ce.getModifiers(),
789                  ce.getComment() == null ? oe.comment() : ce.getComment(),
790                  ce.getPreLines() == null ? oe.preLines() : ce.getPreLines()
791               ));
792               // @formatter:on
793               newEntries.put(section, cs2);
794            }
795            case SET_SECTION -> {
796               var cs2 = cs == null ? new ConfigSection(section) : cs;
797               if (nn(ce.getPreLines()))
798                  cs2 = cs2.withPreLines(ce.getPreLines());
799               newEntries.put(section, cs2);
800            }
801            case REMOVE_ENTRY -> {
802               if (nn(cs))
803                  newEntries.put(section, cs.withoutEntry(ce.getKey()));
804            }
805            case REMOVE_SECTION -> {
806               if (nn(cs))
807                  newEntries.remove(section);
808            }
809         }
810         List<ConfigEvent> newChanges = st.changes();
811         if (addToChangeList) {
812            var c = new ArrayList<>(st.changes());
813            c.add(ce);
814            newChanges = u(c);
815         }
816         state = new State(st.contents(), newChanges, u(newEntries), st.oentries(), st.imports());
817      }
818      return this;
819   }

847   @SuppressWarnings({
848      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for config diff detection
849   })
850   private ConfigEvents findDiffs(String updatedContents) throws IOException {
851      var changes2 = new ConfigEvents();
852      var newMap = new ConfigMap(store, name, updatedContents, format);
853
854      // Imports added.
855      for (var i : newMap.state.imports()) { // HTT - requires active import listeners with actual ConfigMap imports registered
856         if (! state.imports().contains(i)) {
857            for (var s : i.getConfigMap().state.entries().values()) {
858               for (var e : s.oentries.values()) {
859                  if (! newMap.hasEntry(s.name, e.key())) {
860                     changes2.add(ConfigEvent.setEntry(name, s.name, e.key(), e.value(), e.modifiers(), e.comment(), e.preLines()));
861                  }
862               }
863            }
864         }
865      }
866
867      // Imports removed.
868      for (var i : state.imports()) { // HTT - requires active import listeners with actual ConfigMap imports registered
869         if (! newMap.state.imports().contains(i)) {
870            for (var s : i.getConfigMap().state.entries().values()) {
871               for (var e : s.oentries.values()) {
872                  if (! newMap.hasEntry(s.name, e.key())) {
873                     changes2.add(ConfigEvent.removeEntry(name, s.name, e.key()));
874                  }
875               }
876            }
877         }
878      }
879
880      for (var ns : newMap.state.oentries().values()) {
881         var s = state.oentries().get(ns.name);
882         if (s == null) {
883            for (var ne : ns.entries.values()) {
884               changes2.add(ConfigEvent.setEntry(name, ns.name, ne.key(), ne.value(), ne.modifiers(), ne.comment(), ne.preLines()));
885            }
886         } else {
887            for (var ne : ns.oentries.values()) {
888               var e = s.oentries.get(ne.key());
889               if (e == null || neq(e.value(), ne.value())) {
890                  changes2.add(ConfigEvent.setEntry(name, s.name, ne.key(), ne.value(), ne.modifiers(), ne.comment(), ne.preLines()));
891               }
892            }
893            for (var e : s.oentries.values()) {
894               var ne = ns.oentries.get(e.key());
895               if (ne == null) {
896                  changes2.add(ConfigEvent.removeEntry(name, s.name, e.key()));
897               }
898            }
899         }
900      }
901
902      for (var s : state.oentries().values()) {
903         var ns = newMap.state.oentries().get(s.name);
904         if (ns == null) {
905            for (var e : s.oentries.values())
906               changes2.add(ConfigEvent.removeEntry(name, s.name, e.key()));
907         }
908      }
909
910      return changes2;
911   }

919   @SuppressWarnings({
920      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for this specific logic
921      "java:S6541", // Single-threaded context; synchronization unnecessary
922   })
923   private ConfigMap loadIni(String contents, String originalContents) throws IOException {
924      if (contents == null)
925         contents = "";
926      var newContents = originalContents == null ? "" : originalContents;
927
928      // Detach any imports carried by the previous snapshot before rebuilding.
929      state.imports().forEach(Import::unregisterAll);
930
931      var imports2 = mapOfType(String.class, ConfigMap.class);
932
933      List<String> lines = ll();
934      try (var scanner = new Scanner(contents)) {
935         while (scanner.hasNextLine()) {
936            var line = scanner.nextLine();
937            var c = firstChar(line);
938            var c2 = StringUtils.lastNonWhitespaceChar(line);
939            if (c == '[') {
940               var l = line.trim();
941               if (c2 != ']' || ! isValidNewSectionName(l.substring(1, l.length() - 1)))
942                  throw new ConfigException("Invalid section name found in configuration:  %s", line);
943            } else if (c == '<') {
944               var l = line.trim();
945               var i = l.indexOf('>');
946               if (i != -1) {
947                  var l2 = l.substring(1, i);
948                  if (! isValidConfigName(l2))
949                     throw new ConfigException("Invalid import config name found in configuration:  %s", line);
950                  var l3 = l.substring(i + 1);
951                  if (! (isEmpty(l3) || firstChar(l3) == '#'))
952                     throw new ConfigException("Invalid import config name found in configuration:  %s", line);
953                  var importName = l2.trim();
954                  // Circular imports are detected in ConfigStore.getMap() which throws a clean ConfigException.
955                  if (! imports2.containsKey(importName))
956                     imports2.put(importName, store.getMap(importName, format));
957               }
958            }
959            lines.add(line);
960         }
961      }
962
963      List<Import> irl = listOfSize(imports2.size());
964      forEachReverse(toList(imports2.values()), x -> irl.add(new Import(x).register(listeners)));
965
966      // Add [blank] section.
967      var inserted = false;
968      var foundComment = false;
969      for (var li = lines.listIterator(); li.hasNext();) {
970         var l = li.next();
971         var c = firstNonWhitespaceChar(l);
972         if (c != '#') {
973            if (c == 0 && foundComment) {
974               li.set("[]");
975               inserted = true;
976            }
977            break;
978         }
979         foundComment = true;
980      }
981      if (! inserted)
982         lines.add(0, "[]");
983
984      // Collapse any multi-lines.
985      var li = lines.listIterator(lines.size());
986      StringBuilder accumulator = null;
987      while (li.hasPrevious()) {
988         var l = li.previous();
989         var c = firstChar(l);
990         if (c == '\t') {
991            c = firstNonWhitespaceChar(l);
992            if (c != '#') {
993               if (accumulator == null)
994                  accumulator = new StringBuilder(l.substring(1));
995               else
996                  accumulator.insert(0, l.substring(1) + "\n");
997               li.remove();
998            }
999         } else if (accumulator != null) {
1000            li.set(l + "\n" + accumulator.toString());
1001            accumulator = null;
1002         }
1003      }
1004
1005      lines = cp(lines);
1006      var last = lines.size() - 1;
1007
1008      // S1: Looking for section.
1009      // S2: Found section, looking for start.
1010
1011      var state2 = S1;
1012
1013      var sections = listOfType(ConfigSection.class);
1014
1015      for (var i = last; i >= 0; i--) {
1016         var l = lines.get(i);
1017         var c = firstChar(l);
1018
1019         if (state2 == S1) {
1020            if (c == '[') {
1021               state2 = S2;
1022            }
1023         } else {
1024            if (c != '#' && (c == '[' || l.indexOf('=') != -1)) {
1025               sections.add(ConfigSection.parse(lines.subList(i + 1, last + 1)));
1026               last = i + 1;
1027               state2 = (c == '[' ? S2 : S1);
1028            }
1029         }
1030      }
1031
1032      sections.add(ConfigSection.parse(lines.subList(0, last + 1)));
1033
1034      var newEntries = new LinkedHashMap<String,ConfigSection>();
1035      for (var i = sections.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
1036         var cs = sections.get(i);
1037         if (newEntries.containsKey(cs.name))
1038            throw new ConfigException("Duplicate section found in configuration:  [%s]", cs.name);
1039         newEntries.put(cs.name, cs);
1040      }
1041
1042      // entries and oentries start identical; the immutable snapshot is shared safely.  Changes carry over a reload.
1043      var entriesU = u(newEntries);
1044      state = new State(newContents, state.changes(), entriesU, entriesU, u(irl));
1045      return this;
1046   }
